title: Better Chairs
description: Craft a chair using wooden stairs and sit on it
body:
Better Chairs adds new craftable chairs you can right click and sit on

Craft a chair using any wooden stairs and any carpet, place it and sit on it!

Break it with any axe

**Why another chairs pack?**

Many packs allows you to sit anywhere. It in nice but I want to sit on my stairs! Not on dirty flour.

Other packs featuring stairs-only sitting utilize invisible pigs with saddles, which ruin immersion for me.

**FAQ**

Q: how to craft chair

A: combine any wooden stair and carpet in crafting grid

Q: how to sit on chair

A: right click it

Q: how to break chair

A: left click it with any axe
